notes: Vishay D/CRCW e3 Standard Thick Film Chip Resistors, Doc 20035, Revision 14-Apr-2026; archive 59f13d58...bin (sha256 verified, ledger HTTP 200). Pages 1, 2, 6 read (p6 rendered).

Note p1 technical table lists 0.125 W for CRCW0603, i.e. the extended value; the record correctly uses the standard figure and flags the extended rating in conflicts.

t_end 155 degC: p1 permissible film temperature 155 C, operating range -55 to +155 C; p6 derating curve reaches 0 W at 155 C ambient. OK.

derating_knee 70 degC: implied by P70 on p2/p1; explicit knee at 70 C on p6 derating figure (both standard and extended). Value OK; record cites page 2 where only the P70 subscript appears, the curve itself is page 6 (citation imprecision, not a value problem).

mismatches: tcr_max: record says 300 ppm/degC for 'Vishay CPR05' with no resistance condition; datasheet p1 Technical Specifications says +/-300 ppm/C for 1.0 ohm and above and +/-600 ppm/C for less than 1.0 ohm. CPR05 range is 0.1 ohm to 1 kohm, so 300 ppm/C is stated more broadly than the document allows (needs R >= 1 ohm condition or 600 ppm/C for sub-ohm values). Page 1.
